source: review/tactic-book-3a/C7_未通過選項根因分類.md §4 (common conditions, §4-A, §4-B, §4-D) — metrics and reading rules are taken from there; this file adds only what C7 left open (exact arm list under the laneFrame fix, the instrument, the observation-only C4 counters)
authority: Owner 2026-10-22 long-task instruction: C3-3 starts with the C7 §4-B diagnostic, C4 with the §4-D baron diagnostic, C5 with the §4-A positioning diagnostic

seeds.why: draft §1.3 diagnostic range shared by the C7 §4 diagnostics (a diagnostic is not a registration and makes no pass/fail claim); never used by any measurement

design.ruleset: balanceTool.v21 (core.v1, laneFrame teamRelative). C7 §4-A said the red top-lane arm could not be judged before the red top/bot fix; under v21 the fix (D-1 A) is active, so both sides are measured
design.layers: hero skills / passives / power curve on, battle talents off (G-A7 convention); every record carries layers and a mismatch is STOP(INSTRUMENT)
design.instrument: tools/lib/c7DiagSim.mjs (c7DiagSim.v1), self-check gate tools/check_c7_diag_3c.mjs. Read-only; §4-B observes e._joinV3 through an instance-level wrapper that calls the original with the same arguments and returns its value (the gate proves wrapped and unwrapped matches are identical)

arms.what: diagnostic arm, not a candidate option: after configure the side's engine knobs get gankWeights {1,1,1} (same object, property replaced). Blue only: the red engine knobs are a frozen teamRelative conversion and cannot be modified without changing object identity (which would change the rng path)

design.armBuild: every option arm = std template + that single choice via the Resolver's mergeTacticConfig as a legacy input (the four options are in MEASURED_EXCLUSIONS, which createTacticPlan rejects); the opponent and both control sides use the std template without choices through the same legacy path
design.matches: 400 seeds x 10 arms (ctrl + 9 option-side arms) = 4000 matches

4-A (60-480 s, the side's top / mid hero: relWave.<top|mid> (hero distance to own nexus minus own wave front distance to own nexus, 對線 ticks)
enemyGanks.<top|mid> (enemy jungler ganks into that hero's world lane)
4-B (whole match, top / mid / adc heroes: joinGoStartsPerMin.general (READ: joinGo false->true at a roll, C7 definition; hot classified by reference like the engine, so under the engagement FSM every roll is a general hot spot)
joinRollGoPerMin.general (reported: every successful roll incl. true->true)
laneFightEntriesPerMin.general (READ: 團戰! entries of top / mid / adc heroes outside objective windows)
fightEntriesPerMin.general / .objective (all heroes; reported and used for the cross-instrument check)
4-D (whole match, all heroes): entryBaronDistMedian (C7: median distance to the baron pit over every fight entry, no filter)

statistics: paired over seeds vs the control's same side; z = mean diff / (sd / sqrt(n)); rel = diff / control mean; a metric 'moves in a direction' when zDir >= 3 and |rel| >= 5 % (the replication rule); 'reversed' when zDir <= -3

readingRules.4-A: per option and side, design direction: topDef laneForward/relWave down, midAggr up. Checked in this order: relWave reversed (zDir <= -3) => behavioural_reversal (C5; fix needs Owner); else relWave moves in the design direction (zDir >= 3; z only, no |rel| condition because relWave is a signed offset whose control mean can be near 0) while laneForward is reversed => category4_state_composition (change metric); else laneForward not reversed => no_reversal_at_n400 (the original n=40 reversal did not replicate); else unresolved. Arm 4: midAggrNoGank (blue) laneForward not reversed while midAggr blue is reversed => gank weights are the main cause; midAggr blue not reversed => n/a
readingRules.4-B: tight, direction up, read metrics joinGoStartsPerMin.general and laneFightEntriesPerMin.general (moves = zDir >= 3 and |rel| >= 5 %): roll moves on both sides and entries move on both sides => original_family_works; roll moves on both sides but entries do not move on both sides (including one side only) => category4_roll_metric; roll moves on one side only => one_sided (not registrable); roll moves on neither side => category2_not_registrable (phases.*.grouping stays design). Power note: only about 3-11 general rolls per side per match, so the roll metric may sit near the threshold
readingRules.4-D: baronHigh, both sides: objectiveFightEntriesPerMin.baron not reversed (zDir > -3) on both sides => noise_original_reversal; on every side where it is still reversed, entryBaronDistMedian and baronPitFightSecsPerMin both up with zDir >= 3 (z only) => category4_metric_moment; otherwise unresolved

consequences: Diagnostics make no live / pass claim and change no option status. A later registration may only choose metrics consistent with the reading here and must use its own fresh seeds (C3-3 18401-18800, C4 3401-3800, C5 3801-4200).
stopLoss: 4000 matches cap, single look after completion; STOP(INSTRUMENT) on a layers / ruleset / Director-mode mismatch (exit 5); breaker > 20 errored or (>= 1000 attempted and > 0.5 %) (exit 4); STOP file (exit 3); incomplete (exit 6); write-once result tools/fixtures/c7_diag_result_3c.json
